questions.stem: A gas at pressure $3$ atm and temperature $250\ \text{K}$ has a mean free time of $4 \times 10^{-8}\ \text{s}$ between collisions. If the pressure is halved and the temperature raised to $400\ \text{K}$, the new mean free time is close to:

A block rests on a rough incline of angle $30^\circ$ as shown. It just stays at rest when a force of $3\ \text{N}$ acts down the incline, and also when a force of $13\ \text{N}$ acts up the incline. The coefficient of static friction is: $[\,g = 10\ \text{m/s}^2\,]$
questions.solution:
Down: $3 + mg\sin30^\circ = \mu mg\cos30^\circ$; Up: $13 = mg\sin30^\circ + \mu mg\cos30^\circ$.

Adding: $2\mu mg\cos30^\circ = 16 \Rightarrow \mu mg \cos 30^\circ = 8$. Subtracting: $2mg\sin30^\circ = 10 \Rightarrow mg = 10$, so $\mu = \dfrac{8}{10 \cdot \frac{\sqrt3}{2}} = \dfrac{8}{5\sqrt3}$.

A gas-phase reaction $2\text{X} \rightarrow \text{Y} + 3\text{Z}$ takes place in a closed vessel. The concentration of Z rises by $6 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol L}^{-1}$ in $12$ s. The rate of disappearance of X (in $\text{mol L}^{-1}\text{s}^{-1}$) is

Choose the option that best explains the meaning of the idiom in the sentence:

The sudden audit **put a spoke in the wheel** of the merger talks.
questions.solution: To *put a spoke in someone's wheel* means to hinder or obstruct their plans.
